channel.title: Medical devices: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the medical devices sector.

item.title: Hancom Lifecare: Hancom LifeCare signed a KRW 18.96bn contract with the Defense Acquisition Program Administration for the 10th mass production of K5 gas masks.
Bistos: Bistos market capitalization has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days as of Nov 17, 2026, raising administrative issue designation risk.
Genesystem: Genesystem's board decided to issue KRW 2.43bn of Series 2 private convertible bonds to fund a business acquisition.
Rayence: Rayence reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 35.9bn and operating profit of KRW 3.5bn, up 22.2% and 246.3% year on year.
ValueAddedTechnologyCo: Vatech reported Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated revenue of KRW 110.9bn and operating profit of KRW 15.6bn, with a net loss.
Dentium: Dentium reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 78.3bn and operating profit of KRW 15.9bn, with a net loss.
